Scope Agent runtimes by runtime profile (#169)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-61
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    - add strict provider-scoped Agent Runtime Profile maps and atomic routing precedence
    - persist runtime-profile identity and sealed snapshot columns through a guarded PostgreSQL migration
    - isolate Codex, Cursor, and Grok process construction by runtime profile while preserving healthy profiles when another is unavailable
    
    ## Verification
    - `cargo check -p codeon-tracker -p codeon-postgres -p codeon --all-targets`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-tracker --test agent_selection`
    - `cargo test -p codeon --test config`
    - `cargo test -p codeoo-agent-codex process::tests`
    - `cargo test -p codeoo-agent-grok`
    - `cargo fmt --all --check`
